messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "do not take tablets too close to bedtime if you have trouble falling asleep or staying asleep"
set: ["do not take tablets too close to bedtime if you have trouble falling asleep or staying asleep", "call if you have difficulty falling asleep or staying asleep", "continue to take tablets even if you feel well", "problems may occur if you take too much", "do not take the missed dose if you miss a dose of the tablets", "do not use tablet if not broken correctly and piece is too big or too small", "do not crush, chew, or break tablets", "do not split, crush, or chew tablets", "do not take to lose weight", "do not take two 10 mg tablets at once", "take with food and swallow tablets whole; do not crush or chew", "call your doctor if you have trouble swallowing a capsule or tablet", "bedtime", "ask pharmacist for measuring device if you do not have one", "do not take extra dose", "do not take for longer than your doctor tells you to"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
